verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own docs say you can self-host the Community or Enterprise Edition on your own infrastructure, including on-prem, with "full data ownership." That lets you decide where data lives, but only by running the deployment yourself. There is no evidence of region selection for the hosted Hoppscotch Cloud. Community feedback also notes you can't point workspace data to a specific directory, so local storage location isn't selectable either. missing for 10: region/residency selection in Hoppscotch Cloud, documented data-residency or region guarantees, user-selectable local storage location, independent corroboration.
